notes.title: Patch Notes – 21st April 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559312/87bd3cb663f68bca3d6b3f29e64802687f38a6e7.jpg[/img]  

Hello Adventurers! Happy Easter! Here are the patch notes for today’s update.

‎  

[h2]CURRENT QUEST OBJECTIVE:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixing issues with the character controller which is sadly taking time. Slowly making progress, but there are some bugs persisting.
[/list]  

‎  

[h2]NOTEWORTHY NEWS:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Short and sweet again this week. Bunch of fun stuff on the way but it’s in a WIP state and may change, or bugs are persisting stopping it from getting fully checked off the todo list.
[*] Zephyr and I binge-watched Avatar & Avatar 2: The Way of the Water over the weekend. I just keep seeing giant blue people everywhere I look now.
[/list]  

‎  

[h2]PATCH NOTES - 21st April 2025[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Upgraded the core which took. So. Long. Ugh.
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Ladder climbing has been added to the game. If you see a ladder, feel free to climb it. Who knows where it will go?
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Ground work for the new Travel Form & Combat Forms has been implemented. This isn’t a full implementation yet, but base functionality exists. At present you may transform into travel forms (mounts) indefinitely, with limited combat capacity (namely to defend yourself in combat situations), and Combat Forms are temporary, upgradeable transformations that give you access to new transform-specific abilities. As you upgrade your combat forms, you’ll be able to use it for longer and longer.
[/list]  

‎  

[h2]KNOWN BUGS:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Combat Forms currently have no way of cancelling the transform. So if you accidentally transform, you’re stuck like that for 15 minutes. 
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Character controller bugs (a lot).
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Mastery panel hangs slightly when opening. Suspecting a wider issue with the UI.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Click to move doesn’t rotate the character, so it looks weird.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Ranged weapons inexplicably consume vast amounts of remaining ammo on reload.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Inventory hangs when opening, causing a large frame drop.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Character profile doesn’t update equipment slots unless the inventory has been opened first.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Battlegrounds timer doesn’t always activate.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Click to move VFX marker doesn’t always show when using the new character controller.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Warping has inaccuracies causing players to fall through the map when warping within the same map.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Harvestables cannot be harvested when in streaming scenes.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes – 12th April 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559312/87bd3cb663f68bca3d6b3f29e64802687f38a6e7.jpg[/img]  

Hello Adventurers! Here are the patch notes for today's update.  

‎  

[h2]CURRENT QUEST OBJECTIVE:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] The current quest objective is [b]focusing on upgrading the player character controller[/b]. This is essentially about "feel". After all, if the game isn't fun to just run around, no one is going to enjoy it.  
[*] Over-the-shoulder aiming for ranged weapons is being added, alongside sticky targeting, double-click to move (for accessibility), and other quality-of-life improvements that should make exploring, adventuring, and combat much more enjoyable.  
[*] You may recall previous updates with the "tank controller" (which also features a combat aspect as well for quick reactions). These new features build upon that foundation to bring more polish and smoother gameplay.  
[/list]  

‎  

[h2]NOTEWORTHY NEWS:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Seasonal Events are an important part of AEGIS Kingdoms. They’re an opportunity to connect real-world celebrations with in-game adventures. With Easter upon us, AEGIS Kingdoms celebrates the [b]Festival of New Life[/b]!  
[*] You voted, and the community seasonal item this year will be [b]Debbie the Chick[/b] — a huggable little hatchling companion symbolising new life and spring. Expect to see her waddling by your side soon!  
[*] Our beloved mascot [i]Debbie the Chicken[/i] may also be joining the world in-game soon — more on that to come.  
[*] [b]Game Master Weapons[/b] are now being designed and modelled (such as Arvaton’s Blade). These are rare weapons earned through specific quests created by the Game Masters themselves. You’ll be able to obtain their creations by completing their challenges.  
[*] These new weapons should start appearing in-game by the end of April, with their accompanying quests shortly after.  
[/list]  

‎  

[h2]PATCH NOTES - 12th April 2025[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Keybindings have officially arrived in AEGIS Kingdoms! You can now customise an increasing number of inputs to suit your playstyle. Suggestions welcome!  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: The settings menu has received a visual overhaul, along with some new settings to help tweak performance.  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Pressing [i]Escape[/i] now closes windows properly. Yes, apparently there was a wrong way — that’s now gone.  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Large amount of refactoring with input actions. Instead of referencing pure inputs directly, the game now utilises Unity’s new input system. This makes way for better accessibility and expanded controller support.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: The new input system works in tandem with the keybindings setup, giving players more flexibility and customisation over controls. Feedback always appreciated!  
[/list]  

‎  

[h2]KNOWN BUGS:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Mastery panel hangs slightly when opening. Suspecting a wider issue with the UI.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Click to move doesn’t rotate the character, so it looks weird.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Ranged weapons inexplicably consume vast amounts of remaining ammo on reload.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Inventory hangs when opening, causing a large frame drop.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Character profile doesn’t update equipment slots unless the inventory has been opened first.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Battlegrounds timer doesn’t always activate.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Click to move VFX marker doesn’t always show when using the new character controller.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Warping has inaccuracies causing players to fall through the map when warping within the same map.  
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Harvestables cannot be harvested when in streaming scenes.  
[/list]

[h2]PATCH NOTES - 6th April 2025[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Mythical weapon Arvaton's Blade has been added to the game. Wielded by the fearsome pirate Captain Arvaton, this blade is extremely rare and as of yet, unavailable to anyone.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Sprinting lock feature has now been added. Once you deplete your stamina, you'll need to wait until it recovers to 25% before being able to sprint again.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: The Ban Hammer (Mythical) has been added to the game! Happy April Fools! (No seriously it has been added to the game, but it's only available for Moderators). However, variants will be available in the future during seasonal in-game events.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: The Battlegrounds map (unnamed as of yet) has now received properly optimised terrain, inclusive of chunks and imposters (previously just one giant chunk eating into your FPS).  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Mistral (aka the Open Weekends island) has received proper optimised terrain imposters. These reduce polygon count significantly (down to ~2000 polys) while increasing texture resolution. A minor pop-in at terrain boundaries may occur, but should rarely be seen due to distance and occlusion. Feedback welcome.  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Mastery XP now visually updates in the window when the panel is open. It no longer requires a refresh.  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Can now talk with NPCs whilst using the new character controller.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Added new logic to the character controller to streamline interactions.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: You can now select entities with a single mouse click (indicated by the blue ring in-game and unit frame appearing in the UI).  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Inputs have been universally updated for multi-input support, improving accessibility and rebind recognition.  
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: UI windows will now close at 10 metres when sourced from an active target.  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Target entity selection now has a base range of 30 metres for TAB targeting.  
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Fixed a bug preventing players from joining Battleground teams once each team had at least one member. This issue unfortunately halted the internal test.  
[/list]  
‎

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559312/87bd3cb663f68bca3d6b3f29e64802687f38a6e7.jpg[/img]

Hello Adventurers! Here are the patch notes for today's update.


[h2]CURRENT QUEST OBJECTIVE:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The next internal test date has now been confirmed to be [b]4th April 2025[/b], where the team will conduct the various tests on [i][b]Battlegrounds[/b][/i]. If this goes well, we’ll move forward and open it up to the playerbase to register interest.
[*] A secondary stress test is also in the works to stress the PTR with our [b]AdventureBots™[/b]. These are simulated players (bots) driven from a special client. They will run around, patrol, attack things, die etc and generally simulate players for the purpose of [i]~statistics~[/i].
[/list]
‎

[h2]NOTEWORTHY NEWS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant progress has been made on the ‘new’ account system [i](this has been a long time in the works)[/i] so account registration is now through the website (rather than in-game), including email verification / account activation.
[*] This is a unified system, so will act as your single login for all AEGIS games and the forums moving forward (rather than an account for each service). The aim is to unburden you with account as much as possible, and it also means for any future projects that monthly membership could be shared across all games etc (receive perks across your entire account). Obviously the focus is AEGIS Kingdoms, but it’s worth building with longevity in mind, so these types of things are considered.
[*] The [b]AdventureBots™[/b] have been locally tested with great success, so that is now shaping up to be a good stress test for the PTR. The initial ‘AdventureBot Clients’ have been prepped, state machines are all working and overall seems to operate well. The next step will be doing a dry run on the PTR ahead of the stress test to make sure no silly compilation errors or whatnot occur. (Essentially to make the actual stress test go smoothly).
[/list]
‎

[h2]PATCH NOTES – 8th March 2025[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Account registration is now through the website, so the in-game ‘register’ button has been removed entirely. Note: this is not ‘live’ yet (fun fact the ‘account’ button leads to the forums currently), but useful to know for the future when account registration is opened up.
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Minimap is now actually fixed this time, I promise.

[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Added some extremely rare hats.

notes.title: Patch Notes – 2nd March 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559312/87bd3cb663f68bca3d6b3f29e64802687f38a6e7.jpg[/img]

Hello Adventurers! Here are the patch notes for Sunday's update.


[h2]CURRENT QUEST OBJECTIVE:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scheduled the next internal test for Battlegrounds. Date is TBC, with the team still coordinating (being international). This features all the new fixes to try out from the 21st February 2025 internal test. These tests are trying to simulate production environments (normally concentrated stress load) on specific features.
[/list]
‎

[h2]NOTEWORTHY NEWS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A hardware resource issue was identified in the last test with our baby development realm (the realm is affectionately named ‘Avalon’). Avalon just didn’t quite have the horsepower needed to handle Battlegrounds. We’ve now rented out a temporary new dedicated machine we’re calling the ‘Public Test Realm‘ to perform some stress tests over March (and possibly April).
[*] The tests will give a good indication of what a typical realm (read: server where your main character lives permanently) can ‘handle’ at peak times. Essentially, this boils down to spamming the PTR with hundreds of AdventureBots™ from real player clients who will run around, kill stuff (and be killed) for a fun stress test.
[*] At this stage, the PTR is not yet ‘public’ but will be used for Open Weekends when they begin. The PTR is currently scalable at this point, so can be adjusted to suit the tests. This give us the best data for the live realms.
[/list]
‎

[h2]PATCH NOTES – 2nd March 2025[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: The new UI has been added. For those of you who have participated in previous clashes over the last few years, this will be very different from the more cartoony-look of times past. A few non-essential panels have yet to be fully upgraded and will be done in the future.
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Male character customisation has been added inclusive of hair, beard and respective colours. (Female model unavailable for now).
